crosswalks.historical_boundary: Entire Tongatapu island, Kingdom of Tonga
crosswalks.resolution_method: verified island-specific EU5 location tag; legacy full-footprint area fails, but the current cylindrical candidate geometry plus GSHHG land-mask weighting gives approximately 253.9 km2 and should pass the area gate after a reproducible rebuild
required_actions: rebuild accepted geometry from the cylindrical candidate transform and land-mask-weighted footprint area
separate Green/Kirch/Burley model envelope from independent population observations
retain LiDAR 50,000–60,000 estimate as a conflict diagnostic only
re-score only after area ratio is within the 95% boundary tolerance
blocking_reasons: legacy accepted table counts the full 499.65 km2 footprint and area coverage is only about 52%
saturation interval is model-derived rather than independently observed
capacity sources share a Green/Kirch/Burley model family
later LiDAR population estimate is not an intrinsic-capacity label
crosswalks.notes: This is a high-value in-period pressure test for the mechanistic model, but it is intentionally blocked from scale fitting until geometry and source-independence gates are resolved.
